kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Healthcare STERIS : consommables, services, equipements capital pour hopitaux. Segment dominant ~71% du CA FY25. Forte croissance porte par services et consommables, equipement capital plus volatile.
kpis.description_en: STERIS Healthcare segment revenue: consumables, services, capital equipment for hospitals. Dominant segment ~71% of FY25 sales. Strong growth led by services and consumables; capital equipment more volatile.
kpis._specific_to: STERIS hospital infection prevention core franchise

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Applied Sterilization Technologies (AST) : sterilisation contractuelle de dispositifs medicaux et produits pharma par EtO et radioisotopes cobalt-60. Activite la plus rentable et moat elevee (autorisations EPA/FDA difficiles).
kpis.description_en: Applied Sterilization Technologies (AST) revenue: contract sterilization of medical devices and pharma products via EtO and cobalt-60 irradiation. Highest-margin segment and high moat (EPA/FDA permits hard to obtain).

kpis.description_fr: Revenu segment Life Sciences : consommables, services, equipements pour fabricants pharma. Recul FY25 lie a cession CECS. ~10% du CA. Sensible aux cycles capex pharma.
kpis.description_en: Life Sciences segment revenue: consumables, services, capital equipment for pharma manufacturers. FY25 decline driven by CECS divestiture. ~10% of sales. Sensitive to pharma capex cycles.

kpis.description_fr: Backlog commandes equipement capital non livrees au 31 mars 2025. 369.2 M $ a livrer dans 12 mois. Indicateur de visibilite revenu equipement et demande hospitaux US.
kpis.description_en: Unfilled capital equipment purchase orders at March 31, 2025. $369.2M expected within 12 months. Forward visibility indicator for capital equipment revenue and US hospital demand.

kpis.description_fr: Capex segment AST : construction et expansion de sites de sterilisation contractuelle (EtO, irradiation accelerateurs, cobalt-60). Indicateur capacite future AST et moat reglementaire EPA.
kpis.description_en: AST segment capex: build-out and expansion of contract sterilization facilities (EtO, accelerator irradiation, cobalt-60). Forward AST capacity indicator and EPA regulatory moat.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu consolide STERIS sur 3 segments (Healthcare, AST, Life Sciences). Sortie FY22 boost par integration Cantel (Dental cede en FY24). Croissance organique constante currency ~6.2% FY25.
kpis.description_en: STERIS consolidated revenue across 3 segments (Healthcare, AST, Life Sciences). FY22 boost from Cantel integration (Dental divested FY24). FY25 constant currency organic growth ~6.2%.

kpis_story.description_fr: EPA + FDA renforcent règles EtO emissions 2024-2026. STERIS leader investit compliance + alternative tech (X-ray, e-beam). Compétiteurs out, parts marché up.
kpis_story.description_en: EPA + FDA tightening EtO emissions rules 2024-2026. STERIS leader investing compliance + alternative tech (X-ray, e-beam). Competitors out, market share up.

_notes: STERIS = sterilization + infection prevention leader healthcare/AST.
